en: Multi‑view color postcard with an orange border featuring five photographs from Pécs: landscaped gardens with modern sculptures, a colorful geometric outdoor sculpture in front of a stone building, a tall TV/observation tower on a forested hill, and two modernist multi‑storey buildings surrounded by greenery. The back includes handwritten text, a Hungarian stamp showing fruit and labeled "MAGYAR POSTA 2 Ft", printed information in Hungarian, and address lines.
